title: Confirm unchanged engineering ledger without rewriting it
scope: Optimize only identical nonempty shared-ledger comparisons, expose separate request estimate and correct affected offline storage fixtures.
riskAnalysis: Atomic exact Redis comparison remains authoritative. No cached approval, hash shortcut, permission grant, schema migration, history rewrite or financial change. Ordinary writes and expiring rehearsal adapters stay unchanged.

threatModel.assets: Exact ledger bytes, revocation state, leases, historical audit and accounting records.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Local snapshot to atomic provider confirmation, then existing authenticated authority renewal.
threatModel.abuseCases: Stale snapshot confirms a revoked grant, missing value treated as success, mock erases state, or provider failure triggers a retry.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact atomic GET equality on identical nonempty strings only; original CAS for other cases, strict existing0/1result check, no adapter retry and explicit mock script semantics.

rollback: Revert the reviewed feature-branch optimization and restore qualified ff03100 Preview. Preserve every original record; no data migration is needed.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Unexpected provider result and thrown error reject without adapter retries.
negativePaths.stale-state: Changed, differently serialized, revoked and missing snapshots fail exact comparison.
negativePaths.concurrency: Real Redis stale compare plus existing renewal conflict retries require fresh owner and ledger checks.
negativePaths.cancellation: Existing renewal cancellation and beforeCompare guards remain unchanged and focused-tested.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker behavior changes; existing controller cleanup integration remains covered.
negativePaths.api-outage: Provider exceptions propagate; adapter creates no retry or fallback success.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Comparison grants no authority and cannot bypass current owner/source/workspace/lease checks.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No paid calls, provider configuration, accounting settlement or spending policy changes.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Current workflow and receipts unchanged; confirmation changes no revision/history/lease.

defects.rootCause: An unchanged authority snapshot was sent twice and SET back to Redis despite no mutation.
defects.detectionGap: Existing tests checked final bytes only, and seven fake evaluators assumed every Lua script writes two arguments.
defects.regression: One-value/no-write exact confirmation, stale/missing/empty/error cases, real Redis TTL and revocation, plus strict shared three-script offline fixture.
defects.historicalPrevention: Separate no-op confirmation from mutation at the shared adapter; publish both transfer estimates and retain real Redis checks.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse existing adapter and Lua CAS; add no storage key, journal, gateway or orchestration system.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No package, provider, credential, image or network permission changes.
proactiveReview.threats: Do not substitute hashes for exact comparison or reuse cached authority; current atomic and cancellation boundaries remain.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Null/empty retains historical initialization; real writes preserve CAS and expired records cannot confirm nonempty snapshots.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Stale revocation, mismatched bytes, missing records, uncertain responses and cancellation are explicitly covered.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA and Auditor approve runtime2db47;12adapterchecks each. QA additionally approved shared helper3checks and all7consumerpaths.
proactiveReview.recovery: No migration; revert runtime only. All recorded approvals remain consumed/revoked, history and uncertainty remain.
proactiveReview.readiness: 56focused and93consumer checks passed; helper15combinedchecks pass. Complete final CI/Redis/CodeQL/Jekyll/Browser required; no live speed claim.
